newsitem.title: USA: NASD board OKs rule to require recorded calls.
newsitem.headline: NASD board OKs rule to require recorded calls.

text.p: National Association of Securities Dealers Inc said Thursday its board approved a rule that would require brokerage firms to tape record all their brokers' phone calls with investors in certain cases.

NASD said the rule, pending approval by the Securities and Exchange Commission, would require the taped calls if a certain percentage of a firm's brokers were employed by an expelled brokerage firm within the last two years.
NASD said that to ease compliance burdens, it will provide its members with lists of expelled firms and their former associated persons.

NASD said this rule grew out of the results of the Joint Regulatory Sales Practice Sweep Report, a joint effort of the NASD, SEC, New York Stock Exchange, and the North American Securities Administrators Association.
